v4-5.close: And the anointed priest, consecrated with respect to his hands, shall take some of the calf’s blood, and bring it into the Tent of Testimony.

v4-21.close: And they shall carry the whole calf outside the camp, and burn the calf as they burned the former calf. It is the congregation’s offering for sin.

v5-4.close: Or if a soul swears, declaring with his lips to do evil or to do good, whatsoever a man declares with an oath, and it escapes him before his eyes, and he knows it and sins in any one of these matters,

v5-7.candidate: And if his hand cannot provide enough for an animal from the flock, he shall bring unto the Lord for the sin which he has committed two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering.
v5-7.close: And if his means are insufficient for an animal from the flock, he shall bring unto the Lord for the sin which he has committed two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for sin and one for a whole burnt offering.

v7-35.close: This is Aaron’s anointing share and the anointing share of his sons from the offerings of the Lord, on the day when he brought them forward to serve as priests unto the Lord,
